verdict.rationale: Live probes confirm that Windmill serves an llms.txt at windmill.dev/llms.txt (HTTP 200) and markdown versions of its docs pages, such as /docs/intro.md. Many doc URLs in the pack are also .md endpoints, so an agent can ingest the documentation directly. Missing for 10: evidence of llms.txt completeness or depth (e.g., an llms-full.txt or agent-specific usage guidance), and independent reports of agents successfully using these docs.
